title: TheFrozenMod
description: Deep in the tundra lies a mythical ore... one that grants mythical abilities!
body:
# What is this mod?
This Mod adds a new ore to Minecraft, giving you access to food and tools that grant special abilities. For example, ice cubes crafted from raw frozenite grant you super speed. These features grant the user a unique experience and enhances their gameplay.

# Screenshots
![This is an example of the frozenite chisel turning a grass block into a frozen block.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4fce0d04016a6b40555c72824cc403cdc1aa70e.png)

![frozenite ore drops.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5dbd3b10d1596969b5046e0007d10bcad93b908.png)

# Features
- Custom Items that grant special abilities
- Custom Blocks for cool builds.
- Custom Foods that give potion effects.

# Installation
Fabric API is required, download both and place them in your mods folder.
